name: Nera Lockstep
lore: A lantern courier from Brasslock Borough who unlocks impossible routes with enchanted keys and a ghostly last tram.

primary.name: Corkscrew Key
primary.description: Throw a visibly twisting key that pierces up to 2 enemies. Each enemy can only be hit once; walls stop the key.

secondary.name: Latchline
secondary.description: Fire a chained hook that pulls its first enemy up to 140 units toward you and stuns it for 1.5 seconds. Bosses are pulled a shorter distance. Walls block the chain.

special.name: Midnight Express
special.description: Mark ghost rails for 0.75 seconds, then send a wide spectral tram forward. It hits each enemy once, knocks them away and stuns for 0.75 seconds. Buildings stop the tram.

passive: Master Key: Corkscrew Key can pierce one additional enemy.

technique.name: Long Latch
technique.description: Latchline reaches 40% farther, but recharges 25% slower.

final_technique.name: Locksmith’s Garden
final_technique.description: Three delayed key seals deal 24 and briefly stun. Replaces the spectral tram, with no transport or long line sweep.

attack.name: Locksmith’s Garden
attack.description: Three delayed key seals deal 24 and briefly stun. Replaces the spectral tram, with no transport or long line sweep.
